profile.name: Liu Liu
profile.title: Researcher
profile.bio: I am a researcher at Horizon Robotics, focusing on 3D Vision and Embodied AI. My work aims to bridge the gap between visual perception and robotic control through foundation models and generative approaches.

news.content: Three papers accepted to CVPR 2026 (Uni3R, 3D-Fixer, RoboTransfer Findings).
